title: rumohra nipponica
intro: Rumohra nipponica, commonly known as Japanese polypody fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Polypodiaceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The plant is also used for its therapeutic actions, such as lowering blood pressure and improving cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of Rumohra nipponica include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
